name: 风云III典藏版
english_description: Storm 3.8.0, a “collector's edition” compiled internally by the “Storm Studio” team, building on Storm 3.7.4 with previously unreleased or otherwise lost original content. It belongs to this batch's Fengyun III (Storm III) engine branch — its core engine code is nearly identical to fy3xd (the “Xingxing revision”) — and is one of the most content-complete packages in that branch.
